submitted_root_cause: The checkoutservice pods are failing their readiness probes due to an inability to connect to the emailservice dependency, evidenced by 'i/o timeout' errors in logs and readiness probe timeouts. This prevents new pods from becoming ready and contributes to service degradation.
submitted_action: A rollout restart will be initiated for the checkoutservice deployment to refresh its pods, which may help re-establish a connection to the emailservice or resolve any transient issues causing the readiness probe failures.
